name: defect-disposition-preflight
description: Authors this workspace's defect-dispositions.json in full for every inherited defect (FIXED with resolvable path:line evidence, or DEFERRED with a reason) and scrubs every uncited closure claim from all cycle reports before audit.
when_to_use: Select whenever a lane inherits defects from an ancestor cycle, or when the previous cycle's audit FAILed on 'disposition-preflight: MISSING', 'defect(s) inherited ... unaccounted for', or 'closure claim without a citation'.
